canonical_project: Cloud Carrier Southern Highlands Data Campus
notes: Cloud Carrier describes a 67-hectare Southern Highlands Data Campus with DB1 and DB2 coming soon, scalable powered-shell infrastructure, and onsite power of several hundred MW. ABC reported Nakar Property/Cloud Carrier wants gas-fired power stations totalling more than 700MW to run an existing data centre and two planned data centres near Moss Vale; IT capacity was not stated.
